name: 28854-eagle3decode-llama31-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct as the target with lmsys/sglang-EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B as the EAGLE3 draft head. NousResearch is the ungated mirror of the target (same weights; the Llama 3.1 Community License applies). ~16 GB of target weights plus 811 MB of draft head.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one process on one card.
architecture: Target LlamaForCausalLM: 32 decoder layers, GQA with 32 query heads over 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, hidden 4096, dense, KV 128 KiB per token. Draft LlamaForCausalLMEagle3: one decoder layer of the same width, float16, max_position_embeddings 2048 -- which is what caps `context-length`.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 256 requests with a 3600 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, exactly 512 prompt tokens in and exactly 1024 output tokens out with no variance on either, `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0`. Prompts are drawn independently and share no prefix.
purpose: An 8B chat assistant with a draft model, serving eight concurrent users long 1024-token replies on one GPU.
launch:
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
attention-backend: flashinfer

speculative-algorithm: EAGLE3
speculative-draft-model-path: lmsys/sglang-EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B
speculative-num-steps: 2
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 3

# float16 and not the target's native bfloat16: the draft head ships at float16 and one
# --dtype covers target and draft both.
dtype: float16

max-running-requests: 8
cuda-graph-max-bs: 8

# Forced by the draft head's max_position_embeddings 2048; raising it errors out.
context-length: 2048

disable-radix-cache: true
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
